reasons: The cited clause expressly states that nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that Customer remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties, which satisfies the preferred position of no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged from the original.

Deterministic check confirms no requirements-purchase or sole-supplier obligation remains; rationale accurately notes other 'exclusive' references (non-exclusive licence, exclusive jurisdiction) do not restrict sourcing freedom.
